value: Taelan leaves the keep and makes his way out through Hearthglen. The quest turns this departure into an ordeal as Scarlet Crusade forces oppose him. He is no longer the quiet child Tirion watched from exile: he has chosen to break with the order that shaped his adult life. The guards become a last barrier between the Highlord and the open road. The chain gives no private motive to each soldier, and Taelan’s struggle ends at the tower beyond the settlement.
editorNote: The opposition is represented as an ensemble, not an exact count or canonical formation. Quest order names the settlement and outcome but does not support a surveyed route.
